purpose: Run an as-is current IST-DASLab GSQ-RCO Coder prototype against the same B550 code-prompt workload used for the full Flash-Next baseline.

artifact.profile_mapping_validation: The same mapping algorithm reproduced the shipped pinned-revision Coder profile byte-for-byte (SHA-256 a514661124d5305effe9c1bcecff7dc069af398b2b19ff9d11628a2cad0a8915). Mapping the current allocation changes 12,283 of 12,288 profile-order entries.

runtime_configuration.gpus: 2 x RTX 3090 Ti, split 30 with the CPU-root card first
runtime_configuration.settings: 16K context, 2K resident QSA cells, INT8 KV, direct PLE shard 2, split-30, MTP 4, pipeline windows 2, current-revision Coder profile

runtime_state.resident_expert_slots: 7,680 on CUDA0 plus 4,608 on CUDA1 = all 12,288 retained experts
runtime_state.expert_cache_vram: 14.23 GiB on CUDA0 plus 9.19 GiB on CUDA1
runtime_state.gpu_memory_at_idle: 18,630 MiB CUDA0; 22,716 MiB CUDA1; 1,397 MiB VRAM remained free
runtime_state.full_model_comparison_state: The full model loaded 32.23 GiB and cached 23,627 of 24,576 experts (96.14%); Coder loaded 23.42 GiB and cached all 12,288 retained experts.

matched_full_model_comparison.cold_prompt_read: Coder median 3,681.1 tok/s versus full 3,355.9 tok/s; Coder was 9.7% faster on fresh prompt reads.
matched_full_model_comparison.cold_decode: Coder median 151.7 tok/s versus full 132.1 tok/s; Coder was 14.8% faster on this decode sample.
matched_full_model_comparison.cold_four_request_aggregate: Coder median 10.95 tok/s versus full 10.39 tok/s in the FIFO sweep; Coder was about 5.4% faster by this generated-tokens-per-second aggregate.
matched_full_model_comparison.shared_prefix_fresh_read: Coder median 210 ms versus full 192 ms; Coder was 9.4% slower by fresh-read time.
matched_full_model_comparison.shared_prefix_decode: Coder median 121.7 tok/s versus full 143.5 tok/s; Coder was 15.2% slower.
matched_full_model_comparison.shared_prefix_concurrent4: Coder 74.4 aggregate generated tok/s and 2.58 s burst wall versus full 86.1 tok/s and 2.23 s; Coder was 13.6% slower.
matched_full_model_comparison.full_model_concurrent4_cold: The full model completed four unique cold requests at 10.6 aggregate generated tok/s with an 18.187 s burst wall.
matched_full_model_comparison.conclusion: This exact warm code-agent workload does not support Coder as a throughput upgrade. Its measured advantages are lower resident arena size and all-retained-expert residency; its shared-prefix hit path was slower.

subagent_audits.scope: current Coder provenance and profile mapping
subagent_audits.result: required revision bba88856, exact hashes, current allocation mapping, and a separate pack/profile
recommended separating clean timing from instrumentation and preserving cache-hit, PCIe-share, and draft-acceptance context
recommended not promoting a higher-bpw custom decoder until routing, heal, exact pack inversion, quality, and same-day runtime gates pass

validation.result: both hashes matched Hugging Face LFS metadata after 258 MiB/s LAN transfer over the live-resolved en13 path
native pack completed with 1.406 GiB dense and 23.419 GiB experts

validation.command: matched three-round cold/shared HTTP sweep and concurrent4 shared burst

non_claims: No coding-quality, KL, perplexity, vision, long-context, or non-code workload was evaluated.
The current Coder revision is a research scratch artifact; setup.py still pins the older Coder revision and ships the older matching profile.
The current Coder profile was derived from the full-model shipped ranking and current allocation file, not from new routing traces.
The shared-prefix concurrent comparison is one burst per model after priming; it is not a median of repeated bursts.

The full and Coder runs used the same engine binary, prompt, context, KV settings, split-30 GPUs, MTP settings, and storage class, but their quantizations and retained expert counts necessarily differ.
Coder's cold decode advantage did not translate to a shared-prefix hit or concurrent4 throughput advantage.
